preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of points n is between 1 and 2 * 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= r_i <= 10**9 for r_i in map(int, stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split())) for i in range(t))
preconditions.description: For each test case, each layer number r_i is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= c_i <= r_i for c_i, r_i in zip(map(int, stdin.splitlines()[2 + 3*i].split()), map(int, stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()))) for i in range(t))
preconditions.description: For each test case, each point number c_i is between 1 and its corresponding layer number r_i inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()) == len(stdin.splitlines()[2 + 3*i].split()) for i in range(t))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of layer numbers matches the number of point numbers.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(zip(map(int, stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()), map(int, stdin.splitlines()[2 + 3*i].split())))) == len(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()) for i in range(t))
preconditions.description: For each test case, all points are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cost, int) and cost >= 0 for cost in map(int, stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a non-negative integer representing the minimum cost.
The number of outputs matches the number of test cases.
